      Each line is drawn as one continuous route along today's streets between the intersections named in the sources. Where the old street no longer exists (across the Mall, for example), the line runs straight. The Cabin John, Rockville and College Park lines follow today's trolley trails where they survive; the outer ends beyond the city, and the Virginia lines, are sketched from period maps.
